coaching.title: Rest Day
coaching.message: Two days out — complete rest from running today. This is race week, and rest is the work now: no legs on trail, all adaptation. Use the day for race prep instead — bib pickup, pack drop bags, lay out the vest with gels, chews, electrolytes and a backup headlamp, set poles to height, and check the alpine weather so you can pack a rain layer for the Julian Alps.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Carb-load today at roughly 220g+ carbs, leaning toward the higher end and easy-to-digest sources (rice, pasta, potatoes, fruit) to top off glycogen ahead of Thursday. Hydrate steadily with electrolytes rather than plain water. Keep fiber and fat moderate tonight so digestion is settled, not sluggish, by race morning.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Passive recovery only — an easy walk if anything, light mobility, foam roll the calves and quads. Sleep long tonight; the night two out from a race often sleeps worse than race eve itself, so don't stress if it's restless — just protect the window and get to bed early.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Trust the training — the work is done. As you pack drop bags and check the forecast for Kranjska Gora, run the race in your head: the ~2,500m of alpine vert, the weather that can turn fast up high, your pacing plan for the climbs. Rest is a decision, not a skip — you're choosing to show up strong on Thursday.
